Samtec's own scheme makes -F gold flash on contact with matte tin on tail, while the LCSC record lists contact plating as Tin; that disagreement is NOT resolved here, so -F is a plating-only fallback that must be confirmed with Samtec before it is substituted. text_replaces.old: AQROOT FBV2-S1-008... superseded; FBV2-S1-009 final lock. Samtec BCS-112-S-D-HE, verified live 2026-08-23 per D-096: ACTIVE, 385 pieces ship tomorrow, $7.314 @1 / $5.667 @100, UL E111594, RoHS, halogen free, MSL 1, probable COO Malaysia. 2 x 12 = 24 ACTIVE CONTACTS, .100 in / 2.54 mm pitch, FEMALE Tiger Claw dual-beam pass-through socket strip, HORIZONTAL (right-angle) entry, through-hole, 30 uin selective gold in the contact area. FOOTPRINT RE-VERIFIED AGAINST THE SAMTEC RECOMMENDED PCB LAYOUT DRAWING, REVISION B, FIG 3 (BCS-1XX-XXX-D-HE-XXX): 2.54 mm within a row, ROW-TO-ROW .310 +/-.002 in = 7.87 +/-0.05 mm, hole .028 in = 0.71 mm PTH, pin field 27.94 mm for 12 positions. NOT INTERCHANGEABLE with a vertical 2x12 pattern, whose rows are 2.54 mm apart. ODD = ROW A, EVEN = ROW B (D-084). EVERY POWER CONTACT IS VERTICALLY PAIRED WITH GND - 3/4, 9/10, 15/16, 21/22 - so a row-swap mis-insertion can only make a current-limited rail-to-ground short, never 5 V on a logic pin; ALL 3.3 V IS IN ROW A AND ALL 5 V IN ROW B. NO NC CONTACT, NO KEY CONTACT: the enclosure supplies polarisation and keying (D-097) with a >= 1.5 mm recess, an asymmetric upper rib and CLOSED ENDS that make a one-column offset mechanically impossible. Mates with any 0.64 mm square-post header whose mating post is 4.34-6.35 mm; reference TSW-112-07-L-D. BCS-112-L-D-HE is a plating-only cost-down alternate with an identical footprint but only 100 mating cycles against 2500 for -S (Samtec 187544 Rev 1), which is why -S is locked. THE HARWIN M20-7881242 IS REJECTED AS OBSOLETE AND MUST NEVER REAPPEAR (D-083 struck by D-093). ASSEMBLY: if the JLC service cannot place this through-hole part automatically, it is a MANUAL/SECONDARY assembly operation for the first five boards - the connector architecture is not compromised for SMT convenience.
text_replaces.new: AQROOT J5 COMMUNITY PORT. FBV2-S1-008/S1-009 locked a Samtec BCS-112-S-D-HE 2 x 12; FBV2-EXP-002 / D-237 SUPERSEDED it with the Samtec SSQ-124-02-G-S-RA, a 1 x 24, 2.54 mm, FEMALE, RIGHT-ANGLE square-post socket strip presenting one pin per line down the right wall and mating an ordinary male header or Dupont jumper. VERIFIED LIVE 2026-09-18 per D-096 (JLCPCB parts API, record committed at evidence/jlc-live/ssq-124-02-g-s-ra-b06f80e6.json): LCSC C3323671, Samtec, Number of Rows 1, Number of Positions 24P, pitch 2.54 mm, Circular/Square Hole = Square Hole, Mounting Type = Right Angle, contact plating Gold, contact material phosphor bronze, -55 to +125 C, insulation height 2.41 mm, expand library, stock 0. CONFIGURATION per the Samtec SSW/SSQ through-hole datasheet held at vendor/Samtec/samtec-ssw-ssq-through-hole.pdf: SSQ = square tail, 124 = 24 positions per row, 02 = standard-insertion-force lead style, G = 20 uin gold on contact, S = single row, RA = right angle. Body 61.47 mm = 24 x 2.54 + 0.51; pin 1 to pin 24 span 58.42 mm; mates .025 in (0.635 mm) square post; 6.3 A per pin with 2 pins powered; 465 VAC / 655 VDC; 100 mating cycles at 10 uin Au. FOOTPRINT AQROOT_Beta:Samtec_SSQ-124-02-G-S-RA, hole pattern 1.02 mm on 2.54 mm, tail row 6.53 mm inboard of the mating face - that 6.53 mm is the dimension the whole right-wall fit turns on. ORDER-B pin order is SAFE UNDER 180 DEGREE REVERSAL BY CONSTRUCTION: 5V to 5V, GND to GND, 3V3 to 3V3, 3.3 V logic to 3.3 V logic everywhere else - power-to-signal maps under reversal: ZERO (D-238/D-240). The enclosure supplies polarisation: a closed-end 62.5 mm recess against a 60.96 mm male body leaves 1.54 mm of play against a 2.54 mm pitch, so a one-position lateral shift is physically impossible; no electrical key contact and no proprietary shroud. J5.9-12 and J5.15-18 are INTENTIONALLY NC on AQROOT Demo by approved scope. ASSEMBLY: through-hole, MANUAL / SECONDARY assembly for the first five boards - the connector architecture is not compromised for SMT convenience. THE HARWIN M20-7881242 IS REJECTED AS OBSOLETE AND MUST NEVER REAPPEAR (D-083 struck by D-093). The BCS-112-S-D-HE footprint is RETAINED in the library, not deleted, because Beta-DM still uses it.
text_replaces.why: engineering note described a 2 x 12 two-row part, its row-to-row pitch and its row-swap mis-insertion analysis, none of which describes the fitted 1 x 24
